sources.name: goo Housing & Real Estate
sources.coverage: nationwide
sources.notes: The building filter sa_l takes any number (23 wards, used houses, arch[]=1: 150 gave 226 hits, 250 gave 108). Results included large RC houses (e.g. 中野区本町2, 861 m² / 338 m², 'RC造' in the card text), and arch[]=1 (鉄筋系) is the only structure filter in this group, though whether it narrows results is unverified. The sort has no known URL parameter, JPX.cards() pairs catch only おすすめポイント (read areas from the card text), and the same house is listed by several agents.
sources.manual:
1. 23 wards: open https://house.goo.ne.jp/buy/uh/result.html?t=uh&la=shuto&ma=tokyo&jk=1&formtype=AR01&lc%5B%5D=13101&lc%5B%5D=13102&lc%5B%5D=13103&lc%5B%5D=13104&lc%5B%5D=13105&lc%5B%5D=13106&lc%5B%5D=13107&lc%5B%5D=13108&lc%5B%5D=13109&lc%5B%5D=13110&lc%5B%5D=13111&lc%5B%5D=13112&lc%5B%5D=13113&lc%5B%5D=13114&lc%5B%5D=13115&lc%5B%5D=13116&lc%5B%5D=13117&lc%5B%5D=13118&lc%5B%5D=13119&lc%5B%5D=13120&lc%5B%5D=13121&lc%5B%5D=13122&lc%5B%5D=13123&arch%5B%5D=1&sa_l=250 (108 hits when researched). sa_l is the building minimum and takes any number; arch[]=1 is 鉄筋系.
2. Other prefectures: open https://house.goo.ne.jp/buy/{region}_uh/area_{pref}/ to read the city codes (lc[] checkboxes), then build the same URL with la={region}&ma={pref} and one lc%5B%5D={jis5} per city (only la=shuto&ma=tokyo is verified). For land add la_l=500, the largest option (1,000 is not offered; whether la_l takes a free number is unverified), and check ≥1,000 m² per listing. In the 23 wards, check land ≥190 m² per listing.
3. Read cards with JPX.cards(): it finds the cards and their detail links, but its pairs hold only おすすめポイント, so read price, layout and the two m² figures from the card text. Which m² figure is building and which is land is not labelled; confirm on the detail page.
4. JPX.pageInfo() gives the right hits and next link; page with &p=2, &p=3 …, with up to 80 per page via &ps=80.
5. Default order is not by area. To sort, pick 建物面積が広い順 (select#sk value 31) or land, largest first (value 61) in the page's sort select; the URL parameter it sets is unverified.
6. Structure: arch[]=1 is meant to limit results to 鉄筋系, but confirm RC/SRC on each detail page (https://house.goo.ne.jp/buy/uh/detail/1/{jis5}/{030Z…}/{n}/x1{030Z…}.html). The detail label for structure is unverified; card free text sometimes says RC造.

sources.name: Rabby Net (Zennichi)
sources.coverage: nationwide (listings from 全日本不動産協会 member brokers); also a villa section by resort area
sources.notes: Building and land minimums cannot be set in the URL: floor_area_amount:gteq=250 was ignored, and the UI dropdowns (max 150 / 500) are stored in a cookie. Sort by building area, limit and paging work in the URL, and there is no land sort. Structure (構造) is on every card; stock is small (75 new and used houses in all 23 wards, with no RC ≥250 m² seen), and JPX.pageInfo returns hits 0 and next null.
sources.manual:
1. 23 wards: open https://rabbynet.zennichi.or.jp/buy/house/tokyo/area/13101,13102,13103,13104,13105,13106,13107,13108,13109,13110,13111,13112,13113,13114,13115,13116,13117,13118,13119,13120,13121,13122,13123?sort=floor_area:desc&limit=50
2. Other prefectures: open https://rabbynet.zennichi.or.jp/buy/house/{pref_slug}/area (slugs as in the home page links, e.g. nagano), tick every city checkbox (input[name="city_id:in"]) and submit. This gives /buy/house/{pref_slug}/area/{jis5},{jis5},…; add ?sort=floor_area:desc&limit=50 to it.
3. Do not put area minimums in the URL; they are ignored. Rely on the building-area sort (largest first) and stop once building area drops below 250 m². There is no land sort, so check land on every card (≥190 m² in the 23 wards, ≥1,000 m² elsewhere).
4. Read cards with JPX.cards() as is; each card's pairs include 建物面積, 土地面積 and 構造.
5. Ignore JPX.pageInfo (hits 0, next null). Read the total from the 'N件中' text and page by adding &p=2, &p=3 ….
6. Structure is on the card as 構造; the detail page https://rabbynet.zennichi.or.jp/buy/house/{8-digit id} shows 構造 and 建物構造.
7. Villas are at https://rabbynet.zennichi.or.jp/buy/resort/villa (by resort area, e.g. 軽井沢・蓼科, 箱根・富士五湖, 伊豆); that section was not explored.

sources.name: at home
sources.coverage: nationwide (only Tokyo Suginami was tested)
sources.notes: After 3 page loads the automated browser got a GeeTest slide-puzzle CAPTCHA (「認証にご協力ください。」), and in the headless browser the filter panel did not respond and uppercase GET params (?MENSEKI=kt120&SORT=12) were silently ignored (511 hits unchanged). The building-area options stop at 150 m² (kt120) and land at 500 m² (kf014), and structure is not on the cards (only the 鉄筋系 checkbox kh001 in the form). The same house is often listed twice by different agents; the URL form ?basic=kp299,kb208,kt120,kh001&sort=12&limit=50 comes from the site's JS and was never confirmed (its first use drew the CAPTCHA).
sources.manual:
1. This site blocks automated browsers with a CAPTCHA; the owner does these steps by hand in their own browser.
2. Open https://www.athome.co.jp/kodate/chuko/{pref}/{city}-city/list/, e.g. https://www.athome.co.jp/kodate/chuko/tokyo/suginami-city/list/ (this slug form is verified only for Suginami; for towns and villages such as Karuizawa, pick the area with the list page's 市区郡で絞り込む filter).
3. In the left 条件を絞り込む panel, set 建物面積 下限 to 150m², the largest option (250 m² is not offered). Set 土地面積 下限 to 150m² for the 23 wards (190 is not offered) or to 500m², the largest option, elsewhere (1,000 is not offered). Tick 建物構造 鉄筋系.
4. Set 並び替え to 建物面積が広い順 and 表示件数 to 50.
5. Page with the numbered links (path form /list/page2/, /list/page3/ …), and stop once building area drops below 250 m². Skip lots under 190 m² (23 wards) or 1,000 m² (elsewhere).
6. Structure is not on the result cards: open each candidate's detail page (https://www.athome.co.jp/kodate/{10-digit id}/) and read its structure line; the label there was never seen.
7. For villas, use at home's separate resort site https://resort-athome.jp/ (see entry athome-resort).

sources.name: Besso Resort Net
sources.coverage: nationwide villa aggregator of many local agencies (Izu/Atami, Karuizawa/Kusatsu, Hakone, Yatsugatake/Tateshina, Shonan/Miura, Fuji foothills, Boso, Nasu/Shiobara, Okinawa, Shinshu, Hokkaido, Tohoku, Chugoku, Shikoku, Kyushu)
sources.notes: Held a buyer-grade house: https://bessoresort.net/estate-detail28299.htm (伊東市富戸, 構造 RC, 建物 1188.15 m2 on 4035.0 m2, 17,800万円). Results load only by POST after clicking a sort control (the list is empty on first load), there is no GET URL, cards have no <a href> (detail URL is in onclick) and show only one area figure (land) with no structure. Structure is under 構造 on the detail page; the 面積 pair holds '土地面積：… 建物面積：…' together, and listings come from local agencies, so expect duplicates with their own sites.
sources.manual:
1. Open https://bessoresort.net/type1.htm (別荘・一戸建て, nationwide). The list is empty on first load.
2. Click 面積が広い順 (sort by area, largest first); this loads the results by POST (estateTypes=1&extentSort=2), 456 on 2026-11-25, 30 per page. Optionally tick an area (areaMainIds, e.g. 5 伊豆・熱海, 9 軽井沢・草津, 4 箱根, 8 八ヶ岳・蓼科) and set the 面積 minimum to 1000 (extentMin, appears to be land; not tested) before searching. There is no building-area or structure filter.
3. Read the hit count from #mainAreaInner strong.c91c00.
4. Read cards with JPX.cards({ selector: "#mainAreaInner table.Tbl02" }); url comes back null, so take each card's onclick attribute (window.open('/estate-detail{id}.htm')) and open https://bessoresort.net/estate-detail{id}.htm. Cards show land area only.
5. Page with the on-page pager (POST pageNo); there is no GET paging URL.
6. On each detail page read structure under 構造 and split the 面積 value into 土地面積 and 建物面積; the page also names the listing agent (license number, address).
sources.photo_rule: https://bessoresort.net/resort/image/thm_pc_{id}_{n}.jpg (100x100) -> drop thm_: https://bessoresort.net/resort/image/pc_{id}_{n}.jpg (600x400).

sources.name: Nifty Real Estate
sources.coverage: nationwide; merges LIFULL HOME'S, at home, SUUMO, 住環境ホームアドパーク, ピタットハウス, Yahoo!不動産, メジャーセブン and 住まい探しの窓口
sources.notes: robots.txt disallows every filter, sort and per-page parameter (b10= building min, b50= land min, sort=, pnum=, cities=, …). Only unfiltered lists (40 per page, no useful order) and the merged detail pages are allowed, and there is no structure filter. Each detail_{hash} page lists every portal carrying the same house and gives structure under 建物構造 (e.g. 'RC2階建'), so its use is cross-portal dedupe; the default JPX.cards() merged cards and took a /shop/ link, and JPX.pageInfo hits came back null.
sources.manual:
1. robots.txt forbids automated filtered or sorted searches here (any query with b10=, b50=, sort=, pnum=, cities= and more); only the owner can run them by hand.
2. Owner, by hand: open https://myhome.nifty.com/chuko-ikkodate/{pref}/search/ (e.g. https://myhome.nifty.com/chuko-ikkodate/tokyo/search/). Set 建物面積 to 100 m², the largest option (250 is not offered). Set 土地面積 to 180 m² for the 23 wards (190 is not offered) or to 200 m², the largest option, elsewhere. Sort by building area, largest first (sort=area2-desc). There is no structure filter.
3. Automated use is allowed only for unfiltered lists https://myhome.nifty.com/chuko-ikkodate/{pref}/search/ then /search/2/, /search/3/ … (40 per page) and for detail pages /chuko-ikkodate/{pref}/{city}_ct/detail_{hash}/. Use them to dedupe a house already found elsewhere.
4. On list pages use JPX.cards({ selector: "li:has(> div.card.is-floating-shadow)", link: "a[href*=\"_ct/detail_\"]" }) and read the hit count from span.text.is-pj1.is-strong (e.g. '7,491件(1〜40件を表示)').
5. On a detail page, structure is under 建物構造. The 'この物件の販売情報を見る' links lead to Nifty's own per-source pages (/{city}_ct/{suumof|athomef|yahoof|homesf…}_{id}/). Never follow the inquiry buttons, which go to the source portal's form.
sources.photo_rule: Detail photos are the source portal's own full-size files, e.g. https://img01.suumo.com/front/gazo/bukken/.../{nc}_0002.jpg (920x690 measured); use them as is

It held the shared-pool match 新宿区矢来町 SRC 489.53 m2 on 246.94 m2 (OAJ77512, also on smtrc, sumai1, ietan and nomu); JPX.detail() run straight after autoScroll sees only placeholder images, so wait a few seconds.
sources.manual:
1. Open https://www.daikyo-anabuki.co.jp/buy/house/p13/?buildingAreaFrom=200&sort=11 (Tokyo, building >= 200 m2, building area descending; 10 hits). 200 is the largest building option; 250 gives a Not Found page, so check >= 250 m2 on the cards. sources.name: Tokyu Livable
sources.coverage: Greater Tokyo (Tokyo, Kanagawa, Saitama, Chiba, Ibaraki), Kansai (Osaka, Hyogo, Kyoto, Shiga, Nara, Wakayama), Hokkaido, Miyagi, Aichi, Fukuoka, Gifu, Mie, Okayama, Kagawa, Ehime, Kagoshima
sources.notes: There are no area or structure filters, only a prefecture-wide list that can be sorted by building area (Tokyo: 680 hits, and 27 of the first 30 were >= 250 m2). It held a match, 大田区南千束 RC 712.59 m2 on 300.69 m2 (/kodate/C48256956/). JPX.cards() finds the cards but its pairs are empty (labels are inline, e.g. '建物 712.59m2'), and pageInfo next is null because the next link is an icon; structure appears only on the detail page under 建物構造.
sources.manual:
1. Open https://www.livable.co.jp/kounyu/chuko-kodate/tokyo/a13000/?sort=building_area (all of Tokyo, used houses, building area descending, 30 per page). For other prefectures, get the link from https://www.livable.co.jp/kounyu/chuko-kodate/select-area/ (it links /kounyu/chuko-kodate/{pref_slug}/select-area/); only tokyo/a13000 was loaded. Outside Tokyo, sort=land_area sorts by land area.
2. The page is about 1.2 MB and never fires load. Read the DOM once the cards appear, and avoid screenshots.
3. Read cards with JPX.cards(). Pairs are empty, so take '建物 N m2' and '土地 N m2' from each card's text.
4. Page with &page=N (e.g. ...?sort=building_area&page=2), or pass the icon link to JPX.pageInfo({ next: "a[aria-label='次のページへ']" }). Stop once 建物 falls below 250 m2.
5. Structure is not on the cards. Open the detail page https://www.livable.co.jp/kodate/{id}/ and read the 建物構造 label (e.g. 鉄筋コンクリート造 3階 地下1階); coordinates come from its Google Maps ?q=lat,lon link.
6. Do not use the keyword search /kounyu/kw/ with parameters or /kounyu/s/map/ (robots-disallowed). The ClaudeBot group in robots.txt sets Crawl-delay 1.

sources.name: List Sotheby's International Realty

sources.coverage: nationwide resorts and cities (seen: Tokyo 23 wards, Kanagawa, Nagano, Shizuoka, Osaka, Ehime, Fukuoka)
sources.notes: Japan's only Sotheby's office; its JSON API filters used houses (bk_sbt_kbn=122) by land minimum and returns building m² (value.taten_menseki) and a structure code (value.tate_kozo_kbn, 4 = RC; readable.tate_kozo_kbn gives text), but the building-area filter tatesen_menseki_from silently returns 0 for houses and result cards show no structure. Detail label 建物構造; the page is machine-translated into English unless JA is clicked, and JPX.detail() misses 建物（専有）面積. Very slow (page loads ~50 s, API 1-60 s); on 2026-11-25 it held RC matches 渋谷区西原2丁目 267.03 m²/205.45 m² and 長野県原村 477.32 m²/2,276.55 m²; member-only listings (shop_hp_open_member_only_flg=1) are out of scope.
sources.manual:
1. Open https://list-sir.jp/buy/?type=all with page.goto (waitUntil domcontentloaded, long timeout: loads take ~50 s and window.load often never fires), then click JA (a[data-stt-changelang="ja"]) so labels stay Japanese.
2. From inside that page fetch the API (no robots.txt exists): https://list-sir.jp/api/apiHandller.php?type=multiple&search_type=all&search_sort=kokai_upd_date-asc&page=1&filter_condition[bk_sbt_kbn][]=122&filter_condition[tochi_menseki_from]=150&item_count=12&control=2&widearea=select_All&tags= . 190 is not a land option: 150 is the largest option below it (200 was the tested value, 199 hits); for lots outside the 23 wards use tochi_menseki_from=1000 (a form option, untested). Do not use filter_condition[tatesen_menseki_from]: it returns 0 for houses.
3. Keep item_count=12 (100 times out) and page through with page=2, 3, ... until totalCount is reached; allow up to 60 s per call.
4. From each data[] item read value.taten_menseki (building m²), value.tochi_menseki (land m²), value.tate_kozo_kbn / readable.tate_kozo_kbn (structure, 4 = RC), value.lat/lon and readable address; keep houses with building >= 250 m², RC/SRC, and land >= 190 m² in the 23 wards or >= 1,000 m² elsewhere; skip shop_hp_open_member_only_flg=1.
5. Alternative in the page: tick 中古戸建, set 土地面積 下限, press 検索; read cards with JPX.cards({ selector: "li.cards_item", link: "a" }) (title, access, address, price only); the hit count is in #buy_bukken_list_count; more cards load on scroll.
6. Open the detail https://list-sir.jp/buy/detail/?bk_cd={bk_cd}: structure is under 建物構造 (e.g. RC 2階建); JPX.detail() misses 建物（専有）面積, so read it from the page text; coordinates are in hidden inputs lat/lon.

1. Open https://www.bit.courts.go.jp/ (the top page is large and slow; if it stalls, open it again in a fresh tab). robots.txt is absent, but every step below is a POST form, so it must be done by clicking.
2. Click a region on the map, then choose the prefecture (地域から探す) and tick the cities to search.
3. Click 詳しい条件を設定する; choose 種別 戸建て, set 床面積 250 ㎡以上, and set 構造 to 鉄筋コンクリート造 または 鉄骨鉄筋コンクリート造 (per the help pages; not live-tested). For land, the 土地 type has a 土地面積 field.
4. Press 検索; open each 事件番号 in the results (tab 物件詳細).
5. Download the 3点セット PDF (物件明細書・現況調査報告書・評価書) to confirm structure, land and building area.
6. Help pages describing the form: https://www.bit.courts.go.jp/help/help01/help01_03.html (area search, 詳しい条件), help01_08.html (results), help01_09.html (detail and 3点セット). Result and detail selectors are unverified.

sources.manual:
1. robots.txt forbids automated reading of the filtered and paged search, so only the owner can run the house search by hand: open https://kankocho.jp/search/real-estate/ in your own browser, press 一戸建て (12 houses on 2026-11-25), optionally pick a region, and open each item.
2. Automated reading is limited to the unfiltered first page https://kankocho.jp/search/real-estate/ (50 of 113 items, all types) and item pages https://kankocho.jp/items/{id}/ (every item URL is in https://kankocho.jp/sitemap.xml); never add a query string or follow paging.
3. On that page read cards with JPX.cards({ selector: "article" }); use only 延床面積 (the 建物面積, 総戸数 and 専有面積 pairs are empty template fields). Land area and structure are not on cards.
4. On a house item read structure from the 登記簿の表示 text (e.g. '構造　木造亜鉛メッキ鋼板ぶき2階建'); condo items have a 構造 pair.
